objective: Scan every active tradable Alpaca USD crypto pair, eliminate weak setups, and select the strongest qualified crypto winner plus qualified fallbacks for direct Robinhood Crypto API verification.

brokerExecution.rule: Use the Teststock qualified crypto champion first, then already-qualified fallbacks in tournament order. The direct Robinhood Crypto API must independently verify the live quote, account, holdings, open orders, sizing and protection before execution.

timeExit.rule: Revalidate trend, BTC context and liquidity continuously; exit on invalidation or maximum holding window.

timeHorizonPolicy.longTermNote: Crypto is not classified LONG_TERM without independently validated network, custody and fundamental evidence.

requirements: exact symbol returned as API-tradable trading pair
brokerEligibility.rule: Only the direct Robinhood Crypto API may change liveOrderAllowed to true for the current request. A missing/non-tradable pair is rejected.
